sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Endowment Management for Philanthropic and Scientific Grants

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – English Common Law heritage, French Civil Law influence, and customary law norms
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu–New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) / PACER Plus framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 42 of 2014 (as amended); International Companies Act [Cap. 222] ss. 10-11 (name and incorporation), s. 29 (registered office), ss. 44-46 (members' register); Financial Services Commission Act No. 43 of 1993 (as amended); Companies (Amendment) Acts on Beneficial Ownership Disclosure (2016-2019); VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidance (2015, updated).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of proposed member/settlor/beneficiary passport (colour, signed)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public / Commissioner for Oaths in member's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized memorandum and articles of association / foundation charter and statement of purpose
Proof of physical address (utility bill or bank statement, not older than 3 months)
Banker's reference letter on bank letterhead covering financial probity and source of funds
Certificate of good standing / incumbency of any corporate UBO or parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry/file agent of the corporate UBO's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: AML/CFT due diligence questionnaire and source-of-wealth declaration

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Every beneficial owner, director, secretary and authorised signatory is compulsorily screened against: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated List; (ii) OFAC SDN List; (iii) EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists; (iv) Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) domestic list; and (v) VFSC directions on non-cooperative jurisdictions and high-risk countries. PEP status is self-declared and independently verified through open-source checks; enhanced due diligence is mandatory for PEPs, senior corporate officials and any close associates. Screening is continuous where sanctions designations are updated; negative hits trigger immediate Suspicious Transaction Report under s. 23 of the AML/CFT Act.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – International Companies and Trusts Registry, VFSC e-Registry (www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: IC names must be in Latin script using English or French spelling; Bislama names are accepted where Latin transliteration is clear. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, IC, foundation or protected legal-vehicle name. The name must contain a mandatory suffix: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Inc.' or 'Company Limited'. The name must not contravene public policy or misrepresent the entity's personality, nationality, affiliation or purpose.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Foundation (reserved for entities formed under the Foundations Act No. 61 of 2009)
Charitable / Charity (requires prior VFSC approval and evidence of approved charitable objects)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An applicant may apply to reserve a name for a further 30 days on payment of the prescribed fee before expiry. If the Registrar rejects a proposed name under s. 10 of the International Companies Act, the applicant may file a written appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days stating why the name is not prohibited or misleading; the Registrar must give written reasons within 30 days. Any adverse decision can be appealed to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Judicial Review procedure set out in the Judicature Act and Rules of Court. Practical route: instruct a licensed international service provider to pre-screen the name and accompany any rejection with a revised alternative to preserve registration timing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is permissible only in addition to a physical registered office in Vanuatu; the statutory registered office must be maintained in Vanuatu at the registered agent's physical street address and must be staffed by the licensed agent during normal business hours. Remote meeting/administrative addresses are not acceptable as the sole registered office. For an IC holding a charitable-endowment license, the VFSC expects the registered agent to have genuine local substance (physical premises and a qualified compliance officer).
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low—approximately 10% for a low-risk, registered-agent-maintained office; increases to approximately 30% if the entity is flagged for sanctions/PEP-adjacent activity or irregular payment rails. VFSC makes unannounced inspections of registered offices under Part 8 of the Financial Services Commission Act, and registered agents are inspected on a rolling risk-based cycle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government fee for International Company name clearance and incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff – VFSC International Companies (Fees) schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Private Charitable Foundation / Endowment Management license endorsement fee (statutory license required)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff – VFSC Scheduled Licensing Fees for ISIC 6430 activities

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and physical registered office service (first-year inclusive)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Vanuatu International Service Provider / registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark rate among licensed VFSC agents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO piercing, KYC and AML/CFT compliance file compilation (PEP/OFAC/UN screening and beneficial ownership matrix)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed compliance service provider / law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per VFSC AML/CFT rules

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, authentication and consular legalization of constitutional documents and UBO passports in origin country plus Vanuatu representative office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public / Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Vanuatu Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedules and prevailing notary tariffs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal opinion on exempt and charitable status under s. 3 International Companies Act tax exemption
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for exempt-status legal opinions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Secure courier of apostilled/legalized bundles and certified translations (if required)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DHL/FedEx/courier plus translation bureau where needed
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Commercial courier tariff and translation per-page rate

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] of Vanuatu, ss. 6-17 (Registration and Incorporation), ss. 24-27 (Memorandum and Articles), s. 34 (Registered Office and Registered Agent); the objects clause is additionally constrained by the endowment and charitable purpose rules applicable to private charitable foundations under Vanuatu law.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registration Division, Rue Bougainville, Port Vila, Vanuatu (www.vfsc.vu)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form ICA-1 (Application for Registration as an International Company), submitted with the executed and notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association, Consents of Registered Agent, Director and Secretary; the Certificate of Incorporation is issued under the seal of the VFSC Registrar.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. The memorandum need only state an authorized share capital; a nominal subscription of one share at par (USD 1.00) is sufficient. No escrow deposit, capital contribution or paid-up capital verification is required for a non-trading charitable endowment vehicle.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Foundation be established at the office of its Registered Agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, as approved by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED, that the subscription of the founding subscriber for one ordinary share at par, paid in cash in support of the endowment, be and is hereby accepted. RESOLVED, that [Name of Director] be appointed Director and [Name of Secretary] be appointed Corporate Secretary, each to serve until the second annual general meeting, with authority within the objects of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. RESOLVED, that the Managing Director open bank accounts, approve grant policies, and execute all documents required for lawful endowment management and charitable distribution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registration Division, Port Vila (in-person counter or via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a preliminary name search on the VFSC corporate names database to confirm the proposed foundation name is available and does not contain restricted words such as 'bank', 'trust', 'insurance', 'fiduciary' or 'securities', which trigger supplementary licensing. File the name reservation request and obtain the 30-day name hold certificate.
required_dossiers: Objects clause describing charitable and scientific endowment management
Certified copy of the founding subscriber's passport
Letter of mandate from a VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged as misleading, the applicant may submit a written objection to the VFSC Registrar within 7 calendar days, or simply select an alternate name and re-apply; refusal decisions may be appealed to the VFSC Board of Commissioners.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent and Notary Public (Port Vila, Vanuatu)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in full compliance with the International Companies Act [Cap 222], embedding a restricted charitable objects clause (philanthropic and scientific grants, endowment management). The founding subscriber executes the documents before a Vanuatu notary public, who certifies signature and identity.
required_dossiers: Identity and good standing evidence of the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the VFSC issues a composite notice of defect in the constitution, the registered agent amends and re-notarizes the relevant clause within 5 business days and re-files without an additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registration Division, Rue Bougainville, Port Vila, or the VFSC electronic lodgment portal (www.vfsc.vu)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form ICA-1 (Application for Registration as an International Company) together with the notarized constitution, consents of the first director and secretary, and proof of the registered agent appointment. The application must be submitted by the licensed registered agent; all signatures require notarial witnessing.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a query notice is raised, cure deficiencies within 14 business days by lodging corrected forms or further evidence via the registered agent; no new application fee is imposed for a first-cure response.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Official State Filing Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Finance and Administration Department / VFSC designated collection account at a commercial bank in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Remit the statutory filing fee of US$250 by international bank wire, referencing the proposed company name and application number. Deliver the bank wire confirmation to VFSC Finance to facilitate certificate issuance.
required_dossiers: VFSC fee invoice or proforma invoice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: An underpayment is cured within 3 business days by wiring the difference; a duplicate or overpayment may be offset against the first annual renewal fee at the written request of the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Examination and Issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar verifies that the constitution, consents and fees are compliant with the International Companies Act [Cap 222], then seals the Certificate of Incorporation. The company comes into existence upon the date of the certificate, which establishes the Foundation's separate legal personality.
required_dossiers: Complete application file (Forms ICA-1, ICA-7, ICA-9)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Typographical or clerical defects in the issued certificate are cured by a written request for a certificate of correction under section 16 of the International Companies Act within 30 days; substantive rejections trigger a re-application with revised objects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the physical registered office address in Port Vila and execute the Registered Agent Agreement. File the Notice of Registered Office (Form ICA-10) so that the VFSC maintains an accurate public record for service of process and regulatory correspondence.
required_dossiers: Lease or occupancy evidence of the Port Vila office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office is rejected for incompleteness, the registered agent re-files within 5 business days with the lease or occupancy authority; a change of registered office is perfected by filing a fresh Form ICA-10 with the new agent's consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Organizational Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Foundation (registered office, Port Vila)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the board at the registered office, adopt the First Board Resolution covering share subscription, registered office and officer appointments, approve the founding share issuance at par, and open the statutory share register and minute book.
required_dossiers: Draft and Minutes of the First Board Resolution
Share Register and application for shares
Signed consents of directors and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any procedural irregularity is cured via a unanimous written consent resolution executed by all directors under section 45 of the International Companies Act, with effect from the date of the original meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Tax-Exempt Status and Charitable Endorsement Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Charitable Endowment Registration Desk; Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury (Income Tax Office); Department of Labour (OHS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the post-incorporation declaration for non-resident income tax exemption available to International Companies, and register the Foundation's charitable endorsement with VFSC so that endowment assets and grant distributions are administered in conformity with the objects clause. If hiring domestic staff in Vanuatu, register as an employer with the Department of Labour.
required_dossiers: Charitable objects statement certified by the board
Affidavit of non-residence / tax-exempt status form
Bank account opening reference for the grant distribution account
Employer registration form (if local staff are engaged)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax-exempt status is queried, the Foundation's registered agent submits a certified copy of the constitution and a written submission to the Income Tax Office demonstrating that the entity is an International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; a favorable ruling is obtained within 15 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Licensing and Enforcement Department (primary), with environmental oversight by the Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Certificate of Incorporation with a Private Charitable Foundation Endorsement, issued by VFSC under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; a Category B Financial Dealer Licence under the Financial Dealers Act is not required for pure grant distribution but becomes mandatory if the Foundation undertakes fund management, custody or investment advisory services for third parties.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management, Port Vila
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - EIA Screening/Registration only (office-based endowment management with no physical industrial works). A Full EIA Report is not required under the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [Cap 283] and the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations (Order No. 38 of 2011).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process wastewater, VOC or particulate emissions. Office sanitary effluent, if treated on-site, must meet the Vanuatu National Water Quality Standards (BOD less than or equal to 20 mg/L, TSS less than or equal to 30 mg/L). Any standby generator is limited to 200 L diesel storage with bunded containment; ambient noise shall not exceed 60 dBA at the property boundary; general office solid waste must be segregated and removed by the municipal licensed waste carrier.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services for the Port Vila registered office (smoke alarms, emergency exits, portable extinguishers); occupancy permit confirming the leased floor is approved for office use under the Vanuatu Building Code; structural load inspection certificate issued by a Vanuatu-licensed engineer where the office is located above ground level; workplace OHS registration and first-aid compliance with the Department of Labour under the Employment Act and applicable occupational health and safety regulations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official taxpayer portal: https://vrc.gov.vu; customs portal: https://customs.gov.vu; electronic services via the 'My VRC' online filing platform for VBN, VAT registration, and VAT returns.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate an International Company (IC) with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] (expedited same-day incorporation; zero minimum paid-up capital; local registered agent required). Step 2: Apply to VRC for a mandatory Vanuatu Business Number (VBN) for any entity with a Vanuatu nexus (free of charge; online form plus passport, registered agent letter, and certified constitutional documents). Step 3: Assess VAT registration obligation: an IC with annual taxable turnover in Vanuatu exceeding VT 5,000,000 must submit a VAT registration application within 21 days after the end of the month in which the threshold is exceeded; VRC issues a distinct VAT registration number. Step 4: A pure offshore charitable endowment IC that makes no taxable supplies in Vanuatu is not VAT-registrable, but must still hold a VBN and file the annual VFSC compliance declaration. Step 5: Foreign entities appoint a local registered agent for all statutory filings; non-resident directors and shareholders are permitted without a local tax presence.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - An International Company is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, including corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, estate or gift duty, and stamp duty (International Companies Act [Cap 222] s.7). Vanuatu imposes no general income tax regime on any resident or non-resident entity. The sole material indirect exposure is Value Added Tax at 12.5% on taxable supplies made within and in connection to Vanuatu; offshore endowment and grant management services supplied to non-resident founders fall outside this net.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or tax classification election exists because Vanuatu levies no income tax. Applicable statutory elections: (i) voluntary VAT registration under s.8(3) of the VAT Act for an IC making below-threshold but taxable supplies in Vanuatu, subject to a minimum 24-month registration commitment; (ii) election under the International Companies Act to convert an IC into a domestic company under the Companies Act [Cap 191], which terminates IC tax-exempt status; (iii) election to register as a Foundation under the Foundations Act 2016 to operate expressly as a private charitable endowment vehicle; (iv) no hybrid mismatch or CFC elections are recognized in Vanuatu law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998, as amended (administered by VRC)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (Vanuatu Vatu) annual taxable turnover in any 12-month period; registration mandatory from the first day of the month following the threshold breach; voluntary registration available for lower-turnover entities making taxable supplies; no registration required for purely offshore/non-Vanuatu supplies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, no mandatory e-invoicing API, and no digital stamping regime exists in Vanuatu. A VAT-registered supplier must issue a statutory tax invoice (paper or electronic) containing prescribed particulars: supplier name, VBN and VAT registration number, customer name, date of supply, description, quantity, VAT-exclusive price, VAT amount, and total; the invoice must be issued within the period prescribed by the VAT Act (not exceeding 28 days after supply). Electronic invoices are permissible, but there is no Government pre-clearance or interoperability mandate; invoices must be retained for at least five years for VRC audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under s.11 of the VAT Act to: (a) exported goods physically delivered outside Vanuatu within 28 days of supply (or such longer period as approved by VRC); (b) exported services supplied to a non-resident customer where the services are wholly performed outside Vanuatu or the economic benefit is enjoyed entirely outside Vanuatu; (c) international transportation of goods or passengers; and (d) supplies to gazetted international organizations. For an International Company engaged in private charitable endowment management, the 0% rate applies to offshore advisory, custodial, and grant-distribution services rendered to non-resident founders, funders, and philanthropic beneficiaries, provided the service contract provides for performance outside Vanuatu and all consideration is received in foreign currency from abroad.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ECS Single Administrative Document) certified by Vanuatu Customs Service
Commercial invoice / VAT tax invoice expressly identifying the supply as zero-rated export
Transport document: Bill of Lading (marine) or Air Waybill (air) evidencing physical removal from Vanuatu (goods only)
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 / bank credit advice evidencing receipt of foreign exchange from the non-resident customer
Executed contract / grant agreement with the non-resident grantor and, for offshore services, a written declaration of performance location outside Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC may audit and reassess export zero-rating claims within five years of the relevant VAT return date. Failure to substantiate the zero-rating results in a deemed taxable supply at 12.5% with additional tax of up to 200% of the shortfall, statutory interest, and retrospective clawback of any refunded input VAT. Fraudulent zero-rating, false invoicing, or refund abuse constitutes a criminal offence punishable by a fine of up to VT 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to five years; directors, officers, and foundation trustees are jointly and severally liable. The assessment limitation period is extended in cases of fraud or evasion. Vanuatu imposes no statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline; the 180-day benchmark should be written into grant and endowment agreements to satisfy audit expectations and international anti-money-laundering standards.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) is the ultimate monetary and financial stability authority; however, day-to-day oversight of bank licensing and foreign exchange activities is also administered through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for non-deposit-taking financial institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberalised current account and capital account with no general exchange control restrictions. The Vatu (VUV) is convertible for current account transactions (trade, interest, dividends, grants, and charitable disbursements) and for most capital transactions, subject to anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing obligations. Profit or endowment remittance hurdles are minimal; the principal statutory requirements are compliance with the International Companies Act, the Charitable Associations (Incorporation) Act, and submission of accurate underlying documentation to resident banks. Beneficial ownership disclosure and source-of-funds verification are the primary practical hurdles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory timelines or mandatory conversion ratios for export proceeds under Vanuatu law. Residents and non-resident entities may retain export receipts in foreign currency accounts, and the VUV is freely movable. Nonetheless, for anti-money laundering surveillance, banks will require a declared purpose code and retention of commercial invoices or grant agreements for any repatriated funds.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium but highly constrained. Offshore digital EMI (Electronic Money Institution) service providers may offer virtual IBANs or e-wallets to a Vanuatu International Company; however, they are not regulated by the RBV and face an uncertain legal status for handling charitable grant funds. VFSC-licensed money transmitters may be used for non-core ancillary transactions, but the primary treasury infrastructure should rely on VFSC-registered banks or fully licensed foreign banks with physical Vanuatu branches. Legal constraints include WMD and proliferation financing screening, FATF mutual evaluation sensitivities, and the practical refusal of many global EMIs to service Vanuatu tax-exempt international companies.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Most tier-1 domestic commercial banks require at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner to appear physically at a Vanuatu branch for the initial account opening interview, or alternatively at a designated overseas ANZ or BRED representative office when introductorily arranged. Remote opening is not a standard vanilla option; it may be permitted after a prior relationship or via a licensed introducer, but the bank reserves a mandatory video call and notarised passport and corporate document certification. For a charitable foundation, the trustee or founder should expect enhanced due diligence and a face-to-face or secure video interview before the account is activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border grant receipts from foreign donors or a parent endowment entity without a clear commercial rationale
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified deed of endowment, foundation charter or trust deed, donor grant award letter, audited financial statements or third-party accounting certification, a detailed philanthropic grant policy, and a list of intended beneficiaries with risk-based due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Involvement of low-tax or tax-exempt jurisdictions combined with private company ownership of a charitable foundation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full corporate ownership chart, register of directors and shareholders or trustee documentation, legal opinion regarding the foundation's non-profit and charitable status, proof of physical or economic substance in Vanuatu (local registered office, resident agent), and a credible business or grant-making plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High volume of round-trip or same-day transactions disbursing grant funds shortly after receipt
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written grant agreements for each disbursement, beneficiary identification and KYC where applicable, invoice or programme expenditure documentation, a board-approved disbursement matrix, and an independent internal audit trail.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Named as a beneficiary or respondent in adverse media concerning terrorist financing or charitable diversion
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Robust screening reports undertaken within 24 hours of any adverse media, resolution letter from the board of trustees, updated sanctions and PEP checks on all counterparties, and an undertaking to file suspicious transaction reports with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of a regulated bank reference or historical banking activity from the jurisdiction of incorporation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copies of recent bank statements from a regulated foreign bank with solid KYC files, a reference letter from the foreign bank, incorporation and good standing certificate issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, and the original Certificate of Incorporation of the International Company.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The standard inbound lane for capital injection or donor advances is via SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire equivalent) denominated in USD, AUD, NZD, EUR, or GBP, using beneficiary account details at ANZ, BRED, NBV, or BSP. For Vanuatu International Company endowment assets, the recommended purpose code is 'G3R – Transfers of a social nature' for true donations and grants, or 'D2R – Capital transfers' where the injection is structured as an endowment capital contribution. The bank will require a Board Resolution certifying the source of funds, a copy of the donor agreement or deed, and identification of every remitting entity. No VFSC prior approval is required for inbound funds, but the bank reserves the right to quarantine funds pending VFI screening.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound grant disbursements and programme-related payments are cleared through standard correspondent banking rails: SWIFT MT103 for direct wire payments, and Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) for any procurement of goods or services in furtherance of the charitable programme. For high-value grant distributions, banks may settle through the RBV's national payment system for VUV-denominated domestic payments; for cross-border grants, the beneficiary bank must be fully identified and the recipient's charitable or NGO status documented. Payment strings must reference the foundation's registered name, the underlying grant agreement number, and the VFSC company number; any LC must comply with the UCP 600 rules and the bank's compliance sanctions screening procedures.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu foreign exchange forwards (non-deliverable and deliverable where a tenor and pricing curve is bilaterally established with a licensed Vanuatu prime bank)
Offshore Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) executed with an international bank counterparty on a collateralised ISDA Master Agreement
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) available only for material endowment liabilities, subject to RBV and bank-level internal approvals
Vanuatu VUV interest rate swaps and FX swap lines offered by ANZ and BRED for any reinvestment of a substantial endowment fund
OTC vanilla purchased options on USD/AUD or USD/VUV where permitted under the bank's FX complement business and always backed by a commercial or grant disbursement exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form 2) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registry of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts a VUV 50,000 penalty; continued default for 12 months after due date renders the International Company liable to administrative strike-off from the Vanuatu register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee Payment / Registered Agent Good-Standing Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC (submitted through the licensed Vanuatu registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation, concurrently with the annual return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment after two official demands results in cancellation of the international company licence and compulsory deregistration; directors may also be subject to a personal penalty.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit is imposed on a Vanuatu International Company under Cap 222; an independent audit may be required solely by VFSC licence conditions when the entity undertakes licensed financial activity or when shareholders holding at least 10% validly demand an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or Vanuatu-accepted accounting principles; records may be maintained in Vatu or any freely convertible currency approved by the registered agent.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, the registered agent must obtain and certify the current register of beneficial owners; any share transfer must be recorded in the register of members and a copy of the updated UBO confirmation must be retained by the agent for VFSC inspection. The annual return must confirm all movements in shareholding and any change in ultimate beneficial ownership during the preceding year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Members and Directors

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; an International Company (IC) is statutorily exempt from all national taxes, including income tax, capital gains tax, dividend tax and stamp duty.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective tax rate. A private charitable foundation structured as an IC is fully tax-exempt on endowment investment income and grant disbursements. Donations and grants fall outside Vanuatu VAT (12.5%) scope; VAT registration is required only when annual taxable supplies of goods or services in Vanuatu exceed VUV 4,000,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return under Section 133 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222); filed electronically through the VFSC eServices Online Registry maintained by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six (6) months after each anniversary of the date of incorporation of the International Company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name, VFSC registration number and legal form (International Company).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact name as issued at incorporation; the overseas parent or foundation brand name must not be substituted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Vanuatu maintained by the licensed resident agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PO Box alone is insufficient; provide the resident agent's Vanuatu street address and agent licence number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital with indication of paid-up amounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No statutory minimum capital applies; a non-resident settlor may declare one exempt share or nil paid-up capital as applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, dates of birth, residential addresses, and identification numbers of all directors and of the resident company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; attach certified passport copies and a power of attorney granted to the resident agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ultimate beneficial owner(s) of the IC, including the settlor, protector, and controller of the charitable foundation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the natural-person settlor and protectors even if an institutional trustee appears as registered shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of the principal activity (endowment management for philanthropic and scientific grants).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the pure charitable purpose; confirm that no commercial trading is conducted from within Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by directors and the resident agent of compliance with the International Companies Act and the Economic Substance notification obligation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed by a director of any jurisdiction and countersigned by the Vanuatu licensed resident agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a VFSC late-filing fee and daily default charges per the published fee schedule; persistent non-filing triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution of the IC, restoration costs, and loss of the right to transact or hold assets.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu Economic Substance Return (ESR-1) and ESR Notification; filed through the VFSC ESR electronic filing portal under the Economic Substance Regulations No. 140 of 2021.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: ESR-1 must be filed within twelve (12) months after the end of the accounting period; the initial ESR notification must be filed within six (6) months of incorporation or of commencing a relevant activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part A - Entity and Financial Year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity particulars, tax-exempt certificate number, and accounting period start and end dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Align the accounting period with the foundation's endowment reporting cycle; any change of year-end requires prior VFSC approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the ESR category: Holding Business, Fund Management, or other relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A self-settled philanthropic endowment managing only its own corpus should elect Holding Business; do not elect Fund Management unless managing third-party assets for remuneration, which would also trigger financial-services licensing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time employees, physical premises, equipment, and operating expenditure located or incurred in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only actual local substance; foreign back-office staff and offshore investment advisers are not counted toward Vanuatu substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D - Income and Expenditure by Category
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income, deductions, and net result attributable to the relevant activity, supported by a schedule of investment income and grant expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Classify dividends, interest, capital gains, and donation income separately; only Vanuatu-attributable income is tested for substance adequacy.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Attestation that financial statements, grant records, and board minutes are maintained at the Vanuatu registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-language foundation documents must be accompanied by certified English translations filed with the VFSC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file, or filing inaccurate ESR information, attracts penalties up to VUV 10,000,000 with continuing daily default fines; knowingly filing false particulars carries imprisonment; the entity may be struck off and excluded from the tax-exempt certificate regime.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders; no deduction at source is permitted or required under Vanuatu law.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Treaty relief is unnecessary for Vanuatu-source dividends because the domestic withholding rate is already zero. Where the receiving jurisdiction demands proof of tax status, the IC obtains: (1) a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; (2) a Vanuatu Certificate of Tax Exemption or Tax Residence issued by the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) upon application by the licensed resident agent; and (3) any DTA-specific residency certificate required by the foreign tax authority, submitted with the foreign treaty relief claim.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate on outbound royalties and interest paid to non-residents is 0%; Vanuatu has no royalty or interest withholding tax. No two-tier treaty rate reduction is needed; recipient-country domestic tax and controlled-foreign-corporation rules apply unilaterally.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None statutorily prescribed - Vanuatu has no income tax statute and no formal transfer-pricing regime. As prudent ESR-aligned practice, intercompany financing, endowment-management fees, or royalty flows with related parties exceeding VUV 50,000,000 (approximately USD 420,000) per annum should be documented on an arm's-length basis. The ESR applies to all relevant activities without a monetary de minimis threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations (No. 140 of 2021) apply to all Vanuatu International Companies conducting a 'relevant activity', including fund management and holding business. A private charitable foundation managing only its own endowment is treated as a Holding Business and satisfies substance through: a registered office in Vanuatu, a resident director or licensed agent, local premises and staff or contracted agent services, board meetings held in Vanuatu, and adequate records of grant-distribution decisions. If the foundation administers third-party endowment funds for a fee, it falls within Fund Management and must meet the additional CIGA test (core income-generating activities performed in Vanuatu) and must not hold itself out as a passive tax-exempt vehicle.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False ESR Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing false Annual Return or ESR-1 declarations; conducting commercial lending, trading, or fee-charging activity under the charitable banner; deliberately misclassifying endowment income to avoid local substance scrutiny.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment for false ESR statements; daily default penalties; VFSC strike-off and revocation of the tax-exempt certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for restitution of misapplied foundation funds, disgorgement of fees obtained through false declarations, travel bans pending investigation, and custodial sentences for fraudulent misrepresentation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the charitable IC with only a mailbox address, no local governance activities, no grant-making records, and no local personnel; using nominee directors without actual authority; refusing to provide ESR-1 substance data.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR non-compliance determination with penalties up to VUV 10,000,000 and continuing daily fines; strike-off and dissolution of the IC; loss of good standing for treaty attestation purposes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil liability for restoration costs and third-party debts under a veil-piercing theory; director disqualification; adverse cross-border enforcement where the structure is used to evade foreign tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach in Charitable Grant Flows
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting anonymous donations or disbursing grants to sanctioned persons, designated terrorist entities, or politically exposed persons without CDD/KYC and beneficial-owner verification; deliberately structuring cash donations below reporting thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enforcement under the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act and VFSC AML Rules: monetary penalties against the foundation, forfeiture of tainted funds, suspension or revocation of VFSC registration or licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal liability for willful blindness, imprisonment for serious offences, personal asset restraint orders, travel restrictions, and disqualification from serving as directors of any regulated financial entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unauthorized Fund Management / Unlicensed Financial Dealing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Soliciting third-party endowments, issuing units of participation, or providing investment management services to external donors or beneficiaries without a Financial Dealers Licence under the Financial Dealers (Licensing) Act 2011; guaranteeing donor returns from charitable assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties for unlicensed financial dealing, compulsory winding-up of the foundation, claw-back of all fees received with interest, and formal VFSC enforcement notices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for repayment to defrauded grantors or investors, disgorgement of profits, criminal prosecution for carrying on licensable financial activity without a licence, and director disqualification orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Beneficial Ownership Concealment and Nominee Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file or deliberately falsifying the VFSC beneficiary register; using undisclosed nominees or bearer shares to hide the settlor, protector, or ultimate controller of the charitable endowment; instructing the resident agent to withhold information from VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under the International Companies Act and VFSC beneficial-ownership rules, with daily default penalties; strike-off and deregistration; denial of the tax-exempt certificate; statutory reporting to foreign tax authorities under exchange-of-information arrangements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Deemed joint and several liability for all foundation debts where the register is false; fines and imprisonment for false statutory declarations; travel bans and seizure of assets upon contravention.
